title: shift / diff / pct_change：同比环比不用写循环
code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

idx = pd.date_range("2026-01-01", periods=6, freq="MS")
s = pd.Series([100, 110, 121, 133.1, 146.41, 161.051], index=idx, name="revenue")
print("月度收入（固定 +10% 增长）:")
print(s.to_string())

print()
print("=== shift：上一期 ===")
print("  shift(1) =", s.shift(1).tolist())
print("  注意首行是 NaN —— 因为「上一期」不存在")

print()
print("=== diff(n) = x - x.shift(n) ===")
print("  diff(1) =", s.diff(1).tolist())

print()
print("=== pct_change(n) = diff(n) / shift(n) —— 环比 ===")
pc = s.pct_change(1)
print("  " + "  ".join("NaN" if pd.isna(v) else "%.4f" % v for v in pc.tolist()))
print("  首行为 NaN（分母不存在）；其余都接近 0.10 —— 这就是 +10% 的环比")

print()
print("=== 同比：月度数据 lag 12（这里数据只有 6 个月，用 lag 2 演示口径）===")
pc2 = s.pct_change(2)
print("  pct_change(2) =", ["NaN" if pd.isna(v) else "%.4f" % v for v in pc2.tolist()])

print()
print("=== pct_change 的两个边界：分母为 0 与缺失 ===")
z = pd.Series([0.0, 10.0, 10.0, np.nan])
pz = z.pct_change(1)
print("  原始    :", z.tolist())
print("  变化率  :", [("NaN" if pd.isna(v) else ("inf" if np.isinf(v) else v)) for v in pz.tolist()])
print("  分母为 0 -> inf（不是报错）；缺失 -> NaN")
cleaned = pz.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
print("  清洗后  :", cleaned.tolist(), " <- 产报表前必须做这一步")

print()
print("=== 三者关系：diff(n) == x - shift(n)，pct_change(n) == diff(n)/shift(n) ===")
ok = bool(np.allclose(s.diff(1).iloc[1:].values,
                      (s - s.shift(1)).iloc[1:].values))
print("  diff(1) == x - shift(1) :", ok)
